exposure: screening targeted at women undergoing in-vitro fertilisation (IVF)
screening targeted at women with low-lying placentas (LLP)
screening targeted at women with velamentous cord insertion (VCI) or a bilobed or succenturiate (BL/S) placenta
outcome: number of referrals to transvaginal sonography (TVS)
diagnosed and undiagnosed cases of VP
cohort: The study utilized a hypothetical cohort of pregnant women to model the effects of different screening strategies for vasa praevia.
finding: A targeted low-lying placenta (LLP)-based screening approach could detect a substantial proportion of vasa praevia (VP) cases while avoiding VCI overdetection and requiring minimal changes to current clinical practice.
